visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a white puffed-sleeve dress and a black lanyard, stands in front of a dark gray wall with the text 'OPPO AI Phone OPPO Find X9 系列'. She holds a silver smartphone and gestures with her right hand while looking at the camera. The lighting is bright and professional. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a black, cylindrical external lens attachment with 'oppo' and 'H' branding. The background is a blurred indoor environment with green plants. (3) The phone is mounted on a tripod in a landscape orientation, pointing toward a large glass window showing an urban cityscape and a traditional temple-like building. A hand touches the screen to focus and capture. (4) The woman is back on screen holding the phone, pointing at the screen which displays a clear portrait of herself. (5) A close-up of the phone screen shows a photo of the woman with camera metadata overlays. (6) The woman stands in front of a wooden slatted wall, holding the phone with the large lens attachment and pointing to her right. (7) Close-up shots of the phone screen demonstrate camera UI features, including zoom sliders and beauty parameter adjustments. (8) The phone is held horizontally, showing the 'XPAN' mode interface with various filter options at the bottom. (9) The woman stands in front of the initial gray backdrop holding two white phones, one in each hand, smiling and gesturing.

(3) [Subtitle]: 首當其衝的是增距鏡套組. [Variety]: 增距鏡套組. (4) [Subtitle]: 看起來超像迷你版大砲. (5) [Subtitle]: 就連遠處的建築物都可以拍的超清晰. [Variety]: 厲害了吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 看看它的5000萬(畫素)的照片. [Variety]: 5000萬畫素. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的超細. [Variety]: 真的超細. (8) [Subtitle]: 不要不要那麼細以後妝要化好. (9) [Subtitle]: Find X9 Pro 系列加上增距鏡套組. [Variety]: 拍照倍數 120倍 200倍. (10) [Subtitle]: 拍照倍數從120倍變成200倍. [Variety]: 拍遠景 好清晰. (11) [Subtitle]: 人像拍照可以自己設定美顏參數. (12) [Subtitle]: 設好之後存下來之後想請別人幫忙拍照. (13) [Subtitle]: 就不用再調整了喔. (14) [Subtitle]: 我最喜歡的是 XPAN 模式. [Variety]: XPAN 模式. (15) [Subtitle]: 有超多濾鏡可以選擇拍下去有滿滿的. (2) A swift 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between visual cuts while the voice continues describing phone features. (3) A percussive 'click' sound effect mimics a camera shutter as the voice discusses photography quality. (4) Another 'whoosh' transition occurs followed by several short, digital UI 'pop' sounds as interface elements are demonstrated. The music remains consistent in volume and energy level. (5) The female voice increases in pitch and arousal when describing the zoom magnification, punctuated by a melodic stinger SFX. (6) The background music maintains its steady rhythm as the speaker concludes with a welcoming and energetic closing statement. The audio ends with the music fading sharply out.
